Title: General availability: Azure Blob Storage SDK for Go

Body.Content:
We are announcing the general availability of the Azure Blob Storage SDK for Go.

This new SDK allows developers to build Go applications that interact with Azure Blob Storage, allowing developers to store, manage and retrieve massive amount of unstructured data on the cloud. The SDK has been modernized to follow the Azure SDK guidelines and be idiomatic for Go.

Read the announcement blog post for more details and to get started.
